3 Same shelf: genuine against aftermarket at one shop

KS International (UK) lists many of our part numbers twice: a genuine Isuzu part and an aftermarket part. Putting both against our comparison price on the same shelf shows how wide the gap between the two channels is. This is genuine against aftermarket at one shop, not ISZE against KS.
